sections.heading: Where to Launch
sections.body: The affinity index identifies **Tokyo** as the top location with a lift of 1.71 and high confidence [q21, q22]. **San Francisco** follows with a lift of 1.19 and high confidence [q7, q8]. **Seoul** ranks third with a lift of 1.13 and medium confidence [q23, q24].

sections.heading: Who the Players Are
sections.body: The audience for **Ember Crypt** skews male by +18% and female by -18% [q27]. Age skews show a +8% increase for the 35-44 bracket, while those 30-34 are -28% [q27].

sections.heading: Who to Partner With
sections.body: Potential brand partners include **Twitch** and **Unreal Engine** [q31]. For audio and media, consider **Lena Raine** [q28] or the **Giant Bombcast** podcast [q29].

sections.heading: How to Split the Budget
sections.body: From a total budget of $5,000.00, allocate 25.35% ($1,267.67) to **Tokyo** [q21, q22]. Assign 17.61% ($880.53) to **San Francisco** [q7, q8] and 10.10% ($504.69) to **Seoul** [q23, q24].

sections.heading: Caveats
sections.body: The affinity index for **New York** and **London** is 1.00 with low confidence [q3, q4, q13, q14]. **Sao Paulo** shows a lift of 0.93 with medium confidence [q25, q26].

limits: Affinity index, not a sales forecast.
Qloo measures taste affinity from consumption data, not sales or wishlists.
New indie games are usually not in Qloo yet, so the plan works through comparable games.
City-level results cannot be validated with free public data.
Brands are global: Qloo brand affinity ignores location.
